values.binNote: HweiR#DamageOverTime = BaseDamageOverTime + 0.05xap is a per-second rate; the wiki's per-tick value divides it by 4 (one tick every 0.25s), giving base [2.5,5,7.5] and ap coef 0.0125.

values.meaning: tick interval of the aura's damage/slow application
values.quote: dealt {{as|magic damage}} and applied a {{tip|stack}} of ''Despair'' every {{fd|0.25}} seconds
values.binNote: No dedicated bin field states the 0.25s tick rate; it is implied by BaseDamageOverTime being a per-second value split across 12 ticks over the 3s Duration.

values.meaning: Magic Damage (explosion at end of duration or target death)

mechanics.claim: The globule collides with the first enemy champion hit and applies the aura only to that champion (though the aura itself then damages all enemies within it).
mechanics.quote: collides with the first enemy {{tip|champion}} hit, afflicting them with an [[aura]] that grows over 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: The aura deals persistent tick damage to enemies within it, separate from the final explosion damage instance.
mechanics.quote: Enemies within are both dealt {{as|magic damage}} and applied a {{tip|stack}} of ''Despair'' every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: At the end of the duration or if the target dies first, the aura deals a separate explosion damage instance to all enemies within it and removes all stacks.
mechanics.quote: At the end of the duration or when the target dies, the aura explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and remove all ''Despair'' stacks from affected enemies.

mechanics.claim: The tick damage is applied as persistent area damage while the explosion is a single area damage instance.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|persistent area damage}} for the aura and deals {{tip|area damage}} for the explosion.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield can block the aura, the explosion, and the application of the first Despair stack.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} can block the aura, explosion, and the application of the first ''Despair'' stack.

mechanics.claim: Wash Brush lets Hwei exit his current mood (swap Q/W/E form) for free, without triggering that ability's cost or cooldown; it does not deal damage or affect either fight's numbers.
mechanics.quote: '''Hwei''' exits his current ''mood'' without incurring its ability cost or cooldown, toggling it off.

mechanics.claim: Toggling Wash Brush does not count as an ability activation, so it will not trigger on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}
